title: Comparing the Pay Vendor Process in Dynamics SL with Dynamics 365 Business Central

chapters.title: Introduction and Dynamics SL payment selection
SL payment selection process and payment vouchers
Business Central payment journals and suggest vendor payments
Payment suggestion results and payment-per-invoice setting
Vendor priority functionality and priority levels
Filtering by vendor priority and cash flow control

features.name: Payment journals
features.description: Business Central allows users to create payment journals and suggest vendors to pay based on defined criteria.

features.name: Suggest vendor payments wizard
features.description: A wizard that opens to help users suggest vendor payments with saved defaults and filtering options for payment dates and payment documents.

features.name: Vendor priority functionality
features.description: A feature that allows users to set vendor priority levels and use this to filter payment suggestions, ensuring high priority vendors are paid first to control cash flow.

features.name: Payment grouping by vendor
features.description: Option to summarize payments per vendor to create one payment per vendor instead of one payment per invoice.

features.name: Payment amount limit
features.description: Users can specify a total payment amount limit to control how much to pay towards vendor invoices in a payment run.

quotes.text: Business Central allows you to easily create payment journals and suggest the vendors to pay based on criteria you've defined.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core capability of Business Central for automating vendor payment suggestions based on user-defined criteria.

quotes.text: The suggest vendor payments wizard opens. I can select previously saved defaults so that I don't need to re-enter information each time I create
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that Business Central provides workflow efficiency through saved defaults to reduce manual data entry.

quotes.text: By using the vendor priority functionality in Business Central, BC will suggest payments to ensure that we're paying our high priority vendors first.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how vendor priority is a key feature for cash flow management and strategic vendor management.

quotes.text: The lower the number, the higher the priority.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the priority numbering system to understand vendor payment sequencing.

quotes.text: We will then choose to summarize per vendor to create one payment per vendor.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows flexibility in payment grouping options to reduce the number of transactions processed.

quotes.text: Through vendor priority and suggested payments, Business Central helps streamline paying your most strategic vendors and gives you better control of your cash flow.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the key benefits of the payment features for cash flow management and vendor strategy.
